sources: Rockstar Games Episodes from Liberty City materials
notes: Nightlife-focused episode. Adds parachutes, base jumping, club management and golden gun collectibles.
These episodes ship without cheat codes: The Lost and Damned and The Ballad of Gay Tony have none, unlike GTA IV, which uses phone cheats.

items.name: Luis Fernando Lopez
items.summary: Tony Prince's bodyguard and business partner, trying to keep the club and his boss afloat.
items.first_appearance: GTA: The Ballad of Gay Tony

items.name: Tony 'Gay Tony' Prince
items.summary: Luis's boss, a nightlife impresario drowning in debt to the wrong people.

items.name: Yusuf Amir
items.summary: Eccentric billionaire property developer with a taste for gold and helicopters.

items.name: Mori Kibbutz
items.summary: Brucie's brother and Luis's loudmouthed rival.

items.name: Brucie Kibbutz
items.summary: Returns from GTA IV as Luis's occasional ally.

items.name: Armando Torres
items.summary: Luis's childhood friend and partner in the drug trade.

items.name: Henrique Bardas
items.summary: Luis's other childhood friend and crew member.

items.name: Rocco Pelosi
items.summary: Ancelotti associate who keeps dragging Luis into mob trouble.

items.name: Ray Bulgarin
items.summary: Russian crime boss with a grudge against Luis and Tony.

items.name: Gracie Ancelotti
items.summary: Mob daughter whose abduction becomes a bargaining chip.

items.name: Adriana Yanira Lopez
items.summary: Luis's mother, who disapproves of his life choices.

items.name: Dessie and Ron
items.summary: Maisonette 9's door staff and promoters.
